dataset: ALICE S01 existing authenticated author-preprocessed speech and EEG

input.speech: 32 training-only PCA coordinates of frozen Wav2Vec2 last hidden states
input.order: oldest to newest across 1 second; full source coverage required

target.units: FIF-declared volts; no independent physical calibration
target.filter: existing 8001-tap centered VALID FIR, 0.5–8 Hz at 500 Hz, eight seconds future context
target.processing: unchanged cached targets; no extra ICA, channel exclusion, offset fitting or per-segment target normalization

preprocessing.PCA: reuse authenticated PCA trained on segments1–8 only; not reusable for smaller nested training sets
preprocessing.scaling: equal-segment training-only feature and target mean/SD; preserve all channels

architecture.padding: none; crop residual to matching valid output interval
architecture.pooling: mean of valid hidden time samples
architecture.head: linear 53 channels, concatenate progress after pooling

training.sampling: sample training segment uniformly then supported query uniformly
training.checkpoint_selection: final fixed epoch; average all three seeds; no development-selected seed/epoch

controls.wrong_content: swap complete non-progress histories between development9/10 at same query index on common support; no refit/time stretch; descriptive

metrics: per-segment/channel Pearson correlation with undefined cells explicit
limitations: Only one listener and one narrative chapter; development segments previously evaluated.
Provider ICA/bad-channel fitting scope is unknown; inherited channel48 offset and nonzero FIR DC gain remain.
Bidirectional speech features use whole chunks; output timestamps are not physiological latency calibration.
New independent people and content are needed for a publishable generalization claim.
